title: UNI awarded nearly $1M to advance Foundry 4.0 Center
summary_en: The investment will add a 3D sand printer and an induction furnace, helping to enhance foundry operations while strengthening UNI’s ability to support applied research, hands-on, real-world student learning and partnerships with Iowa manufacturers.
title_cn: UNI awarded nearly $1M to advance Foundry 4.0 Center

title: True in spirit, strong in knowledge: 150 years at the University of Northern Iowa
summary_en: The 150-year history of the University of Northern Iowa is featured in the September/October 2026 issue of Iowa History Journal, thanks to an article submitted by Assistant Professor of History Kevin Mason. You can read an excerpt of the story here on Inside UNI!
title_cn: True in spirit, strong in knowledge: 150 years at the University of Northern Iowa

title: UNI expands dementia outreach and education
summary_en: A new space in Bartlett Hall expands UNI’s work supporting people living with dementia, caregivers, families and the professionals who serve them.
title_cn: UNI expands dementia outreach and education

title: A step ahead: UNI’s first nursing students enter final year with extensive clinical experience
summary_en: Students in the first-ever cohort of the University of Northern Iowa’s nursing program are entering their final year with strengthened clinical skills and a strong path to their future as registered nurses.
title_cn: A step ahead: UNI’s first nursing students enter final year with extensive clinical experience
